user.title: Connect to Marshal
user.description: Enter the address of your Marshal instance and an API token with the scopes conversation:write and aitasks:write (create one in Marshal under Security or with `marshal tokens create --name home-assistant --scope conversation:write --scope aitasks:write`).

data_description.token: Shown once when the token is created.

reauth_confirm.title: New API token for Marshal
reauth_confirm.description: Marshal rejected the token or it lacks a scope. Enter a new API token with the scopes conversation:write and aitasks:write.

data_description.token: Shown once when the token is created.

error.unsupported_version: Marshal does not support this integration's API version
error.cannot_connect: Marshal is not reachable at this address
error.invalid_url: Enter a full http:// or https:// address
error.unknown: Unexpected answer from Marshal; see the log
error.missing_scope: The API token lacks the scope aitasks:write

abort.already_configured: This Marshal instance is already configured
abort.reauth_successful: The new API token is saved

missing_scope.message: The Marshal API token lacks the scope {scope}. Create a token with conversation:write and {scope} and enter it in the reauthentication step.

invalid_auth.message: Marshal rejected the API token. Enter a new token in the reauthentication step.

timeout.message: Marshal did not finish the task in time.

not_supported.message: Marshal does not support AI tasks; update Marshal.

daily_cap.message: Marshal's daily cost cap is reached.

no_vision_model.message: Marshal has no model that can look at images for this task.

invalid_output.message: Marshal's answer did not match the requested structure.

server_error.message: Marshal failed to run the task (HTTP {status}).
